crossRefs.note: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.
After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country.
While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.
But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.
Their eyes were opened and they recognized him, then he vanished out of their sight.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach, yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.
translations.bsb: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not recognize that it was Jesus.
translations.kjv: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.
translations.asv: But when day was now breaking, Jesus stood on the beach: yet the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.
